quest.title: Return to Sender
quest.description: You hear a strange recording about the "apocalypse" at the lake to the west of Piramida...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.title: East of the Moon, West of the Sun

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Female Voice
dialogues.text: "...Welcome to Bunker No. (...), friends from afar..."

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Female Voice
dialogues.text: "...If you are listening to this recording, it means that the <color=#FF5E41FF>apocalypse</color> is imminent..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Paimon almost died of fright. She didn't realize this thing could talk! Whoa, whoa, whoa, Paimon's missing something — did it just say something super scary that went right over Paimon's head?

choices.text: I think she mentioned the apocalypse...

response.speaker: Gentle Female Voice
response.text: "...Fortunately, you have found this bunker, and we are grateful to have you here... together... in the bunker at the end of the <color=#FF5E41FF>apocalypse</color>..."

response.speaker: Gentle Female Voice
response.text: "...Please... use the key card... The <color=#00E1FFF>lift</color> connects... safe... take... to the bunker..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, did the mechanism just break? All that fuzzy noise drowned out her voice. Paimon couldn't hear what she was saying...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon can't figure out what this place is... {NICKNAME}, why don't we go inside and take a look?

choices.text: Nothing scary, just that the apocalypse is coming.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's just the apocalypse — that's a big weight off Paimon's chest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Except obviously it's not!!! How can you be so casual about it? That tone — you sound like you're announcing we're having Chicken-Mushroom Skewers for breakfast!

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Maintenance order for <color=#00E1FFF>Research Zone 1</color> complete. Expected duration exceeded by: <color=#FF5E41FF>3,942,176</color> hour(s). A report of negligent conduct has been issued to the supervisory authority.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—How many hours? Whoa, Paimon can only remember the first number. How many others were there after that three?

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Access updated: Senior Technician Kotelnikov. Welcome to the Bunker Access Terminal Server.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Does this thing think we're the maintenance worker sent to repair the purification system...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon guesses that means we can access more places now! Let's see... This one appears to be <color=#00E1FFF>Research Zone 2</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Check on the status of Research Zone 2.)

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Generating status report. Please wait.

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFF>Research Zone 2</color>: <color=#FF5E41FF>Warning</color>. High concentrations of Abyssal contamination and signs of the "Ultimate Calamity" have been detected.

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color> Purification System: <color=#FF5E41FF>Damaged</color>. Senior Technician Kotelnikov, please proceed to perform repairs under the protection of a guard escort.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A guard escort? Paimon doesn't see any guards around here... Wait a second — what did it say has been detected?

choices.text: It sounded like some sort of Abyssal monster...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if the "apocalypse" is actually just an Abyssal monster, then it's probably the source of this place's contamination...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If we can take it down, the Abyssal contamination here should be cleaned up once and for all, right? {NICKNAME}, let's head to <color=#00E1FFF>Research Zone 2</color>!

choices.text: Keep me safe, Guard Captain Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon'll keep you safe! ...Is what Guard Captain Paimon would say — if she had a weapon. Unfortunately, you'll have to watch your own back.

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: Unregistered residents detected. Initiating standard safety inspection protocol...

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: Scan complete. <color=#FF5E41FF>Multiple dangerous items</color> detected. For the safety of other residents, please place all weapons and dangerous items into the designated receptacles.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It wants us to hand over our weapons!?

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: I apologize for any inconvenience. The purpose of confiscating dangerous items is to ensure the absolute safety of the bunker's residents. Your items will be safely stored. You can retrieve your belongings when you leave.

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: If you have any safety concerns, please rest assured, the bunker is equipped with the most advanced <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color> Purification System available. You will encounter no danger here.

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: In the name of Professor (...), I guarantee that no matter what monsters rage beyond the sky's veil, they will not infiltrate our Elysium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhm, beyond the sky's veil? Aren't we at the bottom of the sea?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! It's like those novels in Nasha Town — the "apocalypse" is talking about aliens coming to invade Teyvat...

choices.text: You should really stop reading those trashy pulp fiction novels!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was only joking! Even if there were invaders from beyond the sky, they wouldn't invade a place like this... Uhm, would they?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, since it's a safe bunker, it seems reasonable to take our weapons off for now, right? Unless they're secretly doing bad things in here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like deliberately providing really yucky food... or occasionally breaking the water purifier on purpose... or... locking the main entrance and trapping everyone inside forever...

response.speaker: Ancient Terminal
response.text: Please be assured. This bunker is designed to provide absolute safety. All residents are free to leave at any time they wish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, since the mysterious mechanism says it's all above board... Paimon thinks we should trust it, right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Ancient Terminal
response.text: Thank you for your cooperation. All dangerous items have been collected. Scan complete. No threats detected. Standard safety inspection protocol complete.

response.speaker: Ancient Terminal
response.text: Welcome to the bunker at the end of the <color=#FF5E41FF>apocalypse</color>.

choices.text: Well... that doesn't sound entirely impossible...
So that's what's going on. Maybe Skirk knows more...

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Access granted. Welcome to the Bunker Access Terminal Server.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let me see... This looks like a map of the bunker...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the key card we got last time seems to only give us access to <color=#00E1FFF>Research Zone 1</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Check on the status of Research Zone 1.)

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Generating status report. Please wait.

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFF>Research Zone 1</color>: <color=#FF5E41FF>Warning</color>. High concentrations of Abyssal contamination detected. Current risk of overflow: <color=#FF5E41FF>Extreme</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color> Purification System: <color=#FF5E41FF>Blocked</color>. Maintenance personnel have been dispatched.

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Time elapsed since previous maintenance request: <color=#FF5E41FF>Error</color> standard hour(s). Please do not panic, resident. Stay calm and await supervisory instructions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! This purification system is completely useless!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon thinks she understands now — the "apocalypse" is actually Abyssal contamination, right? *sigh* This bunker was built to keep out the Abyss, but the contamination inside ended up being worse than anything out there...

choices.text: Looks like it failed to keep out the Abyss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we've got to figure out a way to deal with this. Otherwise, the contamination could spill out...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's take a look around Research Zone 1.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's go!

choices.text: Are you sure there isn't more to this story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't know. But if we don't do anything, the Abyssal contamination could spill out... Paimon thinks our only choice is to deal with the problem ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That's that dealt with. What an annoying little...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seemed convinced Teyvat was destroyed, and we were outside the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Let's just forget about that idiot! Right, it looks like we've dealt with that thing — whether it was an apocalypse or just the Abyss!

choices.text: All thanks to the Mandragoras.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and we'd better give credit to that researcher named Grazina, right? Paimon wonders what happened to her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, that just about wraps everything— Huh? Wait! What's this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Proof of the Cognoscenti!? What's that doing in a place like this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it looks like it was left by Reed Miller himself... This means we're one step closer to the Great Treasure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon can't wait to find out what it is!

choices.text: All thanks to my sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You weren't even using your sword! Oh, that reminds Paimon — we can't forget to pick up our stuff before we leave the bunker...

talks.objective: Enter the experiment site and adjust the valves

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: Maintenance complete. <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color> Purification System: <color=#FF5E41FF>Operating Normally</color>. <color=#3399CCFF>Key card</color> unlocked.

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: Don't forget to retrieve your key card. Have a wonderful day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Looking closely, this card seems to be a different color from the one we got earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't know who left it here, but we should take it. Maybe we can find its owner... Oh, right, there doesn't seem to be anyone else here...

talks.objective: Return to the main control terminal

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: Maintenance complete. <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color> Purification System: <color=#FF5E41FF>Operating Normally</color>. <color=#3399CCFF>Key card</color> unlocked.

dialogues.speaker: Automated Bunker Threat Response System
dialogues.text: Don't forget to retrieve your key card. Have a wonderful day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this time, the key card's golden...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That terminal report before mentioned signs of large monster activity in Research Zone 2... There's no way it could be talking about the one we just saw, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon doesn't get it. For now, let's head back to the terminal and see what this card unlocks.

talks.objective: Return to the main control terminal

dialogues.speaker: Bunker Access Terminal Server
dialogues.text: Access updated: Senior Researcher Grazina. Welcome to the Bunker Access Terminal Server.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! It looks like that key card we just picked up still works!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which makes Paimon think, this Grazina person must have been a pretty big deal — they seem to have had access to the entire bunker...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, it looks like the only place we haven't been to yet is the <color=#00E1FFF>Supervisory Office</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that "apocalypse" thing is still hanging around, this is the only place it could be. Hmm, Paimon thinks that whatever it is, it's probably not that scary, since scary things wouldn't want to hide from us!

choices.text: We'd better keep our eyes peeled — never underestimate an enemy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's go check out the <color=#00E1FFF>Supervisory Office</color>!

choices.text: Everything should want to hide from us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, we're experienced adventurers after all! Even without weapons, {NICKNAME} can take down any monster with just a bish — bash — bosh!

dialogues.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
dialogues.text: Grazina...? You backstabbing snake, how dare you show yourself before me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, watch out! That monster seems to have been lured out!

dialogues.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
dialogues.text: No, no, you're not Grazina... I can't detect your scent. What are you? A living being, or another spirit flying aimlessly across the bedeviled sky?

dialogues.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
dialogues.text: No living creature can enter this grave... Their grave, our grave. Answer me! Did Professor Rotwang send you here? Has my master forgiven me?

choices.text: Are you the "apocalypse"?

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color>? <color=#FF5E41FF>Apocalypse</color>! Heh... Haha... Look at the world out there! <color=#FF5E41FF>The apocalypse</color> has already descended upon us!

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: Young Solovei tried to stop it, and Brahe, who impersonated Reed Miller. Even that treacherous snake, Grazina — she tried to stop it, too... But their efforts were all in vain. It came... It still came!

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: My master... Professor Rotwang... reduced that pathetic world to ashes with the "SAMPO." After all that destruction, this bunker is all that remains, isolated amid the bedeviled sky...

choices.text: You think the world has been destroyed?

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: The world outside is nothing but a casket for things beyond their time... I know not from whence you came, but I have already broken free of the celestial shell, no longer to suffer the shackles of gravity and fate!

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: And you? You are no servant of my master, yet neither are you just another fool... Will you join us — become one with our flesh and our blood — or will you welcome death right here?

response.speaker: The "Ultimate Calamity"?
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Join</color>...

response.speaker: The "Ultimate Calamity"?
response.text: Or <color=#FF5E41FF>die</color>?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The world hasn't been destroyed. You're at the bottom of the sea.

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: Enough! Cease your vicious lies, vile desecrater! My master would not deceive me — we exist amid the bedeviled sky!

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: Let them be interred in the ruins of that extinguished world. Only we shall continue our existence amid the bedeviled sky — Master, bear witness!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ugh, there's no other way. {NICKNAME}, let's try using these plants to deal with it!

choices.text: The world outside's doing pretty well.
I've had enough of your nonsense. Feel the blade of my sword!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Paimon has no idea what you're babbling about... Wait! "Feel the blade of my sword"? You mean the one that's still stored at the entrance!?

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: No matter... No matter! Ignorant fools — even if that snake Grazina has imprisoned me here, your flesh and blood will still become tomorrow's sustenance...

choices.text: Rotwang is dead, and you're next.

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: Heh... Haha... I thought I was the only one who could deceive those fools with such crude lies. I didn't expect you to use my own tricks against me...

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: Don't think you can fool me! Don't think you can fool us! Professor Rotwang can never die. No... Never! Otherwise, how could Teyvat have been destroyed, and how could we be drifting amid the bedeviled sky?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Teyvat hasn't been destroyed. You're at the bottom of the sea.

response.speaker: Ultimate Calamity
response.text: Enough! Cease your vicious lies, vile desecrater! My master would not deceive me — I have already broken free of the celestial shell, no longer to suffer the shackles of gravity and fate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That's that dealt with. What an annoying little...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seemed convinced Teyvat was destroyed, and we were outside the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Let's just forget about that idiot! Right, it looks like we've dealt with that thing — whether it was an apocalypse or just the Abyss!

choices.text: All thanks to the Mandragoras.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and we'd better give credit to that researcher named Grazina, right? Paimon wonders what happened to her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, that just about wraps everything— Huh? Wait! What's this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon doesn't get it. So this thing is the "Proof of the Cognoscenti"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a little rusty, but it still looks like a super expensive antique... Could this thing hold some special meaning for the Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we'd better take it with us! Paimon has a feeling it's gonna come in handy!

choices.text: All thanks to my sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You weren't even using your sword! Oh, that reminds Paimon — we can't forget to pick up our stuff before we leave the bunker...
